# ArcisAI
# https://arcisai.io
# Contact: marketing@arcisai.io | +91-968-777-9999
# Last-Updated: 2026-10-09

> ArcisAI is an AI CCTV and video-surveillance brand from Adiance Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India). Its range covers IP cameras, network video recorders (NVRs), a cloud/on-premise video management system (VMS), a bridge device for existing ONVIF cameras, and ArcisGPT, a natural-language video search tool.

This file is a plain summary of the public ArcisAI website for people and software that read it. It is not a ranking or recommendation of any company. Product specifications vary by model, so check the product page or datasheet for the model you are considering.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://arcisai.io/): overview of the ArcisAI product range.
- [S-Series cameras](https://arcisai.io/s-series): bullet, dome and PTZ cameras with on-camera analytics; connectivity options vary by model (4G, Wi-Fi, PoE).
- [ECO-Series cameras](https://arcisai.io/eco-series): bullet, dome and PTZ cameras in the ECO range.
- [Wi-Fi CCTV cameras](https://arcisai.io/wifi-cctv-camera): Wi-Fi camera models and how they compare.
- [NVRs](https://arcisai.io/arcis-nvr): network video recorders in 4, 8, 16 and 32 channel configurations.
- [Cloud VMS](https://arcisai.io/cloud-vms): video management for cameras at one or many locations.
- [Arcis Bridge Device](https://arcisai.io/arcis-bridge-device): connects existing ONVIF cameras to ArcisAI VMS.
- [ArcisGPT](https://arcisai.io/arcisgpt): search recorded video by describing what you want to find.
- [Edge AI](https://arcisai.io/solution/edge-ai): what on-camera AI does and how it differs from cloud AI.
- [Compliance guide](https://arcisai.io/cctv-compliance-2026): background on BIS-ER and STQC requirements for CCTV in India.
- [Certifications](https://arcisai.io/certifications): certification information published by ArcisAI.
- [Certificate verifier](https://arcisai.io/tools/certificate-verifier): how to check a certificate on the official portals.
- [CCTV storage calculator](https://arcisai.io/tools/cctv-storage-calculator): estimate NVR or hard-disk storage from camera count, resolution, codec and retention.
- [About](https://arcisai.io/about-us): company information.
- [Contact](https://arcisai.io/contact-us): quote, demo and consultation requests.

## Certifications and compliance
ArcisAI publishes BIS-ER and STQC certification information on https://arcisai.io/certifications and https://arcisai.io/cctv-compliance-2026. The scope of each certificate (which products or software it covers) and its current validity should be confirmed against the official records: BIS at https://crsbis.in and STQC at https://www.stqc.gov.in. Regulatory requirements can change; check the official sources for the current position.

## Products in brief
- S-Series: AI cameras (bullet, dome, PTZ); see each product page for resolution, connectivity and supported detections.
- ECO-Series: camera range with Wi-Fi, PoE and 4G models; see each product page for specifications.
- NVR: 4, 8, 16 and 32 channel recorders.
- Cloud VMS: multi-site live view, playback and alerts.
- Arcis Bridge Device: brings existing ONVIF cameras into ArcisAI VMS.
- ArcisGPT: natural-language search across recorded video.

## Company
ArcisAI is a brand of Adiance Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
